A '''Stasis pod''' was a piece of technology that could be used to transport biological material, or in critical situations, persons in a state of suspended animation. [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] [[Trident-class surveyor ship]] had two experimental stasis pods located in the medical suite/science lab.
